Strong Team: Work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and operators.

Overview

As Head of Growth, you will own one of the company's most important strategic assets: the supply side of our marketplace. The systems you build will directly determine our ability to serve customers, launch new products, enter new domains, and maintain our quality advantage.

This role sits at the intersection of growth, product, engineering, recruiting, and operations. Early on, you'll develop the playbooks yourself. Over time, you'll partner closely with engineering to transform those playbooks into software, automation, and scalable systems, all towards the end of creating a repeatable engine that can identify, recruit, and retain exceptional talent globally.

Responsibilities

  • Build the Expert Network

    • Design and execute the strategy for sourcing expert independent contractors across professional domains

    • Develop scalable acquisition channels for highly qualified talent

    • Build systems for identifying and targeting professionals in specific industries, geographies, and specialties

    • Create repeatable playbooks for recruiting niche expert populations on demand

    • Optimize funnel performance from sourcing through activation

    • Measure expert satisfaction and lead the team in ensuring experts are unblocked and satisfied with their experience

  • Build Growth Infrastructure

    • Partner closely with Engineering to build internal growth tools and automation systems

    • Design scalable workflows for sourcing, outreach, qualification, onboarding, and engagement

    • Develop experimentation frameworks and growth loops

    • Create data systems that improve acquisition efficiency over time

    • Reduce manual operational effort through automation and productization

  • Marketplace Operations

    • Forecast supply needs based on customer and project demand

    • Ensure the right experts are available at the right time and quality level

    • Develop segmentation, matching, and workforce planning systems

    • Monitor marketplace health metrics and capacity constraints

  • Build and Lead a Team

    • Recruit and manage a high-performing team of growth associates

    • Coach managers and individual contributors

    • Build a culture of urgency, ownership, and continuous improvement

  • Cross-Functional Leadership

    • Partner with Product and Engineering to prioritize systems that improve scalability

    • Work with Operations to improve contributor quality and retention

    • Collaborate with Leadership on company growth strategy and expansion into new expert categories

Required Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in growth, recruiting, talent marketplace, operations, or related functions; direct experience building talent marketplaces, labor marketplaces, or expert networks is preferred

  • Experience partnering deeply with engineering and product teams; high technical aptitude understanding

  • Experience building and scaling systems rather than simply executing processes

  • Strong analytical and operational capabilities

  • Demonstrated ability to hire and lead high-performing teams

  • Exceptional execution velocity and willingness to operate hands-on

  • Strong ownership mentality and bias toward action

Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend

About AfterQuery

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company's success. Join at an early stage, grow alongside the business, and participate directly in the upside you help create. As we scale, so will your opportunities, responsibilities, and impact.

Strong Team: Work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and operators.

Overview

AfterQuery is hiring a GTM (Go-to-market) Operations Lead to power the throughput of our revenue engine. Sales Ops at AfterQuery is accountable for the machinery behind every deal and for metrics like close rate and time-to-close. You will work alongside Engagement Managers (EMs), taking end-to-end ownership of the execution layer of that machine so the team can spend more time with customers.

This is a role for someone who can switch altitudes. In a single day you might reconcile an invoice, rebuild a pipeline dashboard, assemble the data package for a frontier-lab RFI, and then step back and propose how to automate the whole workflow so it never needs manual touch again. The work can be unglamorous, but is mission-critical in equal measure, and you’ll be judged on throughput, accuracy, and how much of your own job you make disappear.

You won’t inherit a mature RevOps stack. You’ll inherit a fast-moving one (e.g., Attio for CRM, Ramp for billing, an internal data and analytics site) and a mandate to make it hum. Bonus points if you architect the future, improving our sales process and building infrastructure to 10x our business without increasing manual burden.

Responsibilities

  • Architect CRM and pipeline hygiene. Keep deal records, stages, and dashboards accurate and current; run the execution layer of deal management and dashboarding so leadership always has a trustworthy pipeline view and EMs are held accountable.

  • Standardize how we pitch and sell. Partnering with EMs and delivery leads to codify a repeatable sales process to optimize for quality and velocity.

  • Own analytics & attribution. Track deal pipeline, sales attribution, and ROI on sales events (conferences, dinners, etc.). Build forecasting and reporting to tell us what’s working.

  • Drive RFI and inbound request responses. Gather, format, and assemble dataset materials and data-site outputs for customer RFIs with speed and attention to detail.

  • Run contract-to-cash execution. Manage invoicing and accounts-receivable follow-up with our Accounting team, and support contracting, documenting process for future team members.

  • Own and automate the sales stack. Identify and set up whatever tools the team needs to succeed — lead-gen, outreach, and beyond — then partner with ops and engineering to automate the manual work out of it, so your scope gets more strategic over time.

  • Own follow-ups and triage. Track and execute first-touch follow-ups from conferences and customer meetings; triage website inbound so qualified lab conversations reach the right person fast; facilitate clean hand offs between Sales and other teams so nothing drops between a closed deal and delivery.

  • Design customer engagement cadences. Consult with EMs and client delivery leads to learn, then automate project status and customer-facing updates to drive project outcomes.

  • Build strategic customer collateral to drive outcomes. Maintain and improve customer-facing data offering and product updates, and build effective suite of materials to enable our customer engagement team.

What we’re looking for

  • 5-7+ years of experience in sales operations, revenue operations, business operations, banking/consulting, or a similarly execution-heavy, analytical role; you’ve built sales or revops from 0 to 1, and/or have grown a similar team at a fast-growing startup.

  • Proven high-volume execution: you can run ten workstreams in parallel, keep every ball in the air, and your error rate stays near zero. Detail is not a chore for you; it’s a reflex.

  • Altitude switcher: equally comfortable doing data entry at 9am and proposing a process redesign at 3pm. Neither phases you.

  • Systems thinking: you have strong opinions on a revenue tech stack, and learn AI-native tools fast (CRMs like Attio/Salesforce/HubSpot, billing systems, spreadsheets at an advanced level). You instinctively look for automation.

  • Strong communicator: you’re a storyteller with numbers - i.e. clear, concise customer-facing updates, internal status reports, and clean documentation informing action.

  • High agency, low ego. You don’t wait to be assigned; you see the gap, close it, and iterate.

  • Comfortable in a 5-day in-office SF environment that prizes speed, direct feedback, and rapid context-switching.

Preferred Qualifications

  • You’ve worked in or around AI, data, or developer-facing products and can speak credibly about datasets and model training.

  • You’ve built automations (Zapier/Make, scripts, CRM workflows) that eliminate a recurring manual process.

  • Exposure to contracting, procurement, or AR processes at a B2B company.

Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend

About AfterQuery

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company's success. Join at an early stage, grow alongside the business, and participate directly in the upside you help create. As we scale, so will your opportunities, responsibilities, and impact.

Strong Team: Work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and operators.

Overview

As an Engagement Manager, you will act as the main relationship owner for AfterQuery's most important frontier AI lab customers, focused on renewals, expansion, and lasting partnerships rather than one-off deals. They'll pursue new revenue within existing accounts, run senior-level touchpoints like quarterly reviews and contract negotiations, and feed customer input back into product and engineering decisions. As one of the company's first hires dedicated to this function, they'll also be building the account management and customer health processes from scratch while helping shape how AfterQuery approaches customer relationships going forward.

Responsibilities

  • Own and grow strategic accounts: Serve as the primary point of contact for key frontier AI labs, driving retention, expansion, and long-term partnerships.

  • Drive revenue growth: Identify and close upsell, cross-sell, and new use-case opportunities across existing customers.

  • Lead executive relationships: Run business reviews, strategic check-ins, and commercial negotiations, including master services agreements.

  • Champion the voice of the customer: Partner closely with operations, product, and engineering to ensure customer needs are met and feedback shapes our roadmap.

  • Build the customer engagement function: Create account management, customer health, and expansion playbooks from the ground up as one of AfterQuery’s first dedicated customer engagement managers.

  • Operate as an early company builder: Drive cross-functional initiatives and help define how AfterQuery engages with customers as we scale.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ YOE in a relevant role- strong candidates often come directly from account management roles at data companies or engagement management roles in other industries.

  • High agency, drive, and a strong work ethic; thrive in ambiguity and execute with minimal direction

  • Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to hold the room with senior AI researchers and technology industry executives.

  • Competitive nature and demonstrated past success

Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend

About AfterQuery

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company's success. Join at an early stage, grow alongside the business, and participate directly in the upside you help create. As we scale, so will your opportunities, responsibilities, and impact.

Strong Team: Work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and operators.

Key Responsibilities

Project and client management: Work with the world’s leading AI organizations to build next-generation data solutions that push the limits of model capability, while directly driving revenue.

Manage expert teams across technical domains: Lead and coordinate highly specialized contributors across fields like electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, semiconductors, hardware design, and more to create high-quality outputs at scale.

Shape how AI systems are trained: Design dataset specifications that directly influence how frontier models are evaluated and improved. Your technical judgment and problem-solving abilities will help shape what foundation models become.

Drive high-impact execution end-to-end: Own critical projects from idea to delivery. From scoping and breaking down complex engineering problems to executing, iterating, and shipping solutions in a fast-moving, high-stakes environment, you will touch it all.

Gain top-tier operational experience: Support the team across a range of operational initiatives that will directly contribute to the future of AfterQuery. You will work across multiple parts of the business in the same week, ranging from building, analyzing, coordinating, and executing where needed most.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a closely related technical field.

  • 3+ years of experience in engineering, technical research, hardware development, or software engineering roles involving physical systems.

  • Strong technical problem-solving abilities, with the ability to break down unfamiliar engineering problems, understand technical constraints, and reason through how complex systems work.

  • Demonstrated hands-on engineering experience through designing, building, simulating, testing, or investigating substantial technical projects.

  • Familiarity with engineering design, simulation, testing, or verification processes.

  • High agency and strong work ethic; comfort defining problems and thriving with minimal direction in ambiguous situations.

  • Demonstrated leadership excellence and strong communication abilities.

  • Genuine passion for AI and an entrepreneurial inclination.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in semiconductors, chip design, electronic circuits, PCB design, CAD, hardware engineering, manufacturing, or engineering automation.

  • Python proficiency or experience with engineering software, CAD/EDA tools, simulation environments, or technical automation workflows.

  • Experience with physical systems, engineering design, or applied technical research through professional work, internships, or independent projects.

  • Strong coding abilities or experience developing tools and workflows to automate engineering processes.

  • Advanced degree (MS/PhD) in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field.

  • Familiarity with Claude Code or similar AI-assisted workflows.

  • Demonstrated ability to scale technical systems and apply strong reasoning skills across unfamiliar engineering domains.

Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend

About AfterQuery

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company's success. Join at an early stage, grow alongside the business, and participate directly in the upside you help create. As we scale, so will your opportunities, responsibilities, and impact.

Strong Team: Work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and operators.

As the Data Acquisition Lead, you will own AfterQuery's data acquisition commercial strategy: how we find and reach the companies that own valuable real-world data, how we price it, and how we negotiate and close those purchases. You'll own sourcing strategy, pricing and negotiation for our largest and most complex data deals. You'll work across Ops, Research, Legal and Engineering to determine what data assets to target and how to effectively obtain those assets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Data Acquisition Strategy: develop and continually refine AfterQuery's data-acquisition strategy, identifying where proprietary enterprise and other data can meaningfully improve frontier model training and prioritizing target industries and partners accordingly, working in conjunction with the RL team and leadership.

  • Sourcing Strategy: design a scalable system to reach the institutions and owners most likely to sell high ROI data, with support from Marketing.

  • Build and Lead a Team: recruit and manage a high-performing team of associates to help source data acquisition opportunities; coach and manage the associates and build a team culture of urgency, ownership, and continuous improvement

  • Deal Negotiation & Ownership: Personally lead negotiation of AfterQuery's highest-value, most complex enterprise data-purchase agreements, from term sheet through signature.

  • Pricing: set offer prices, deal structures and walk-away points in a market with little public pricing data, where no two datasets are alike

  • Vendor & Partner Management: Build and maintain a portfolio of enterprise data relationships, negotiating pricing, licensing terms, and renewal/expansion agreements.

  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with Engineering, Ops, Legal, and Research to ensure acquired data meets technical and compliance requirements and translates into usable training assets.

  • Compliance & Governance: Ensure all data purchases meet legal, IP/copyright, privacy and data-governance standards.

  • Reporting & Forecasting: Own the data-acquisition budget, pipeline, and forecasting, reporting progress and ROI to executive leadership.

  • Operational Support: Contribute to company-wide initiatives across building, analysis, coordination, and execution as AfterQuery scales.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience negotiating and closing high-value enterprise deals, in enterprise data acquisition, strategic partnerships, corporate development, enterprise sales, or data/vendor licensing negotiation, including people-leadership experience

  • Demonstrated track record personally negotiating and closing complex, high-value enterprise deals, ideally data-purchase agreements (seven figures or more)

  • Deep understanding of data licensing structures, data rights/IP considerations, and data governance and compliance frameworks, or the ability to learn them quickly alongside Legal. Deal-making experience matters more than data experience

  • Experience designing a scalable outbound or sourcing motion to reach many potential counterparties, and pricing assets that have few public comparables

  • Excellent executive-level negotiation, communication, and relationship-building skills

  • High agency and strong work ethic; comfort operating with minimal direction in ambiguous, fast-moving environments

  • Genuine passion for AI and an entrepreneurial inclination

  • Demonstrated competitive success

Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend

The AfterQuery Research Scholar program is a semester-long collaboration for students pursuing ambitious, publishable work in one of AfterQuery’s focus areas:

  • Data quality and data mix

  • Post-training research, including supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning

  • Agent and foundation-model evaluation

  • Public benchmarks in coding and specialized domains such as medicine, finance, law, and STEM

Projects are shaped around each scholar’s interests, with the goal of producing a joint publication. Scholars receive weekly mentorship and hands-on support with engineering, datasets, human annotation, and compute resources. A cash award is provided if a jointly authored paper from the collaboration is accepted for publication.

Responsibilities

  • Define and execute a focused project with an AfterQuery research mentor, aligned with your interests and at least one core research area.

  • Formulate research questions, design rigorous experiments, and analyze the results.

  • Develop the datasets, methods, evaluations, or benchmark assets the project needs.

  • Document methods and results clearly and work with AfterQuery’s research and engineering teams to make the work reproducible.

  • Co-author a paper and work toward publication.

Required Qualifications

  • Full-time undergraduate/master/PhD student with an established publication record

  • Ability to participate in an ongoing research collaboration throughout the academic semester.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Research publications at leading conferences or peer-reviewed journals.

  • Experience developing, publishing, or contributing to public benchmarks.

Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend

About AfterQuery

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company's success. Join at an early stage, grow alongside the business, and participate directly in the upside you help create. As we scale, so will your opportunities, responsibilities, and impact.

We're looking for a Quality Control Lead to own the final checkpoint between raw data and delivered product. You'll be the person who decides what's good enough to ship, the coach who helps contributors get better, and the builder who automates away the errors that shouldn't happen twice.

Key Responsibilities

  • Final Quality Review: Own the last quality checkpoint before datasets are delivered or published, auditing outputs (including code, technical, and reasoning data) for correctness, clarity, structure, and adherence to spec.

  • QC Process & Tooling: Work with infrastructure engineers to continuously automate and improve QC workflows

  • Cross-Functional Feedback Loop: Partner with data delivery teams to identify systemic quality issues, feed corrections back into contributor training, and prevent recurrence.

  • Metrics & Reporting: Own quality metrics and KPIs, reporting on error rates, root causes, and improvement trends to company leadership.

  • Operational Support: Contribute to company-wide initiatives across building, analysis, coordination, and execution as AfterQuery scales.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in a technical role (software engineering, data science, ML engineering, or similar) with hands-on proficiency in at least one modern programming language

  • Proven ability to review, debug, and evaluate both code and technical data and knowledge work data for correctness, structure, and quality; demonstrated rigor in reviewing others' work

  • Experience building or leading a quality assurance/quality control function, ideally for a technical or data-centric product

  • Extremely high attention to detail and comfort making judgment calls on ambiguous or contested technical content

  • Strong leadership and communication skills; able to translate technical quality issues into clear, actionable feedback across a distributed team

  • High agency and strong work ethic; comfort operating with minimal direction in ambiguous, fast-moving environments

  • Genuine passion for AI and an entrepreneurial inclination

  • Demonstrated competitive success

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in AI training data, RLHF, or data-annotation quality assurance

  • Background reviewing datasets across multiple domains (code, reasoning, knowledge work)

  • Experience designing rubrics, grading criteria, or automated quality-check tooling/scripts

  • Familiarity with Claude Code or similar AI-assisted workflow tools

  • Computer science degree or equivalent hands-on engineering background

Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend

About AfterQuery

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company's success. Join at an early stage, grow alongside the business, and participate directly in the upside you help create. As we scale, so will your opportunities, responsibilities, and impact.

Strong Team: Work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and operators.

Overview

The world's leading AI labs are racing to build smarter models and the data behind them is the bottleneck. We're looking for a Project Manager to sit at that bottleneck: managing expert teams, shaping dataset specs, and driving high-stakes projects from scoping to delivery for the organizations building the frontier.

Key Responsibilities

  • Project and client management: Work with the world’s leading AI organizations to build next-generation data solutions that push the limits of model capability, while directly driving revenue.

  • Manage expert teams across domains: Lead and coordinate highly specialized contributors across fields like finance, software engineering, law, and more to create high-quality outputs at scale.

  • Shape how AI systems are trained: Design dataset specifications that directly influence how frontier models are evaluated and improved. Your taste and judgement will shape what foundation models become.

  • Drive high-impact execution end-to-end: Own critical projects from idea to delivery. From scoping, executing, iterating, and shipping in a fast-moving, high-stakes environment, you will touch it all.

  • Gain top tier operational experience: Support the team across a range of operational initiatives that will directly contribute to the future of AfterQuery. You will work across multiple parts of the business in the same week, ranging from building, analyzing, coordinating, and executing where needed most.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience at a top-tier management consulting firm (MBB or similar), Big 4 strategy practice, or corporate strategy team

  • Background in business strategy, case analysis, market research, or corporate operations

  • Strong grasp of structured problem-solving, business frameworks, and financial/quantitative analysis

  • High agency and strong work ethic; comfort defining problems and thriving with minimal direction in ambiguous situations

  • Demonstrated leadership excellence and strong client-facing communication abilities

  • Genuine passion for AI and an entrepreneurial inclination

  • Demonstrated competitive success (e.g., top-tier academic achievement, case competitions, or promotion on an accelerated track)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Python proficiency or experience with data analysis tools

  • MBA or advanced business degree

  • Experience using AI tools to automate workflows, conduct research, or build products

Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a workplace free from discrimination and harassment. Employment decisions are made without regard to legally protected characteristics under applicable federal, state, or local law.

About AfterQuery

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company's success. Join at an early stage, grow alongside the business, and participate directly in the upside you help create. As we scale, so will your opportunities, responsibilities, and impact.

Strong Team: Work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and operators.

Responsibilities

  • Project and client management: Partner directly with frontier AI labs on their legal data and evaluation needs — scoping the problem, translating it into a deliverable program, and driving revenue.

  • Manage expert contractor teams: Recruit and lead practicing attorneys and specialists across practice areas and jurisdictions — litigation, corporate and M&A, regulatory, IP, tax, employment — and hold a high bar on the quality of what they produce.

  • Shape AI training: Design the specifications behind legal reasoning datasets, contract and document review tasks, statutory and case-law interpretation problems, multi-step research workflows, and the rubrics used to grade them.

  • Define what "correct" means: Build the grading standards and evaluation criteria that let a lab distinguish real legal reasoning from confident-sounding error, including citation integrity and jurisdictional accuracy.

  • End-to-end execution: Own projects from scoping through final delivery, in a fast-moving environment where the spec often does not exist yet.

  • Operational impact: Support initiatives across building, analysis, and coordination

 

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years practicing law at a leading firm, in-house at a sophisticated company, a government or regulatory body, or a legal AI startup.

  • JD (or equivalent qualification) and a track record of substantive legal work: you have drafted, negotiated, litigated, or advised, not just coordinated.

  • Deep command of legal reasoning and research methodology, and strong opinions about what separates rigorous analysis from surface-level answers.

  • High agency and the ability to execute in ambiguity; comfort defining the problem before solving it.

  • Analytical ability; can break down complex legal problems and work flows into component parts.

  • Genuine passion for AI and interest in entrepreneurship.

  • Demonstrated track record of competitive success.

  • Strong leadership and communication skills.

  • Comfort with data and AI tools.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Python proficiency or hands-on experience with data analysis.

  • Experience with legal technology, e-discovery, contract analytics, or AI-assisted legal workflows.

  • Depth in a technically demanding practice area (securities, antitrust, tax, patent prosecution, complex regulatory).

  • Multi-jurisdictional or non-US legal experience.

  • Experience using AI tools to automate workflows and build products.

 

Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend

About AfterQuery

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company's success. Join at an early stage, grow alongside the business, and participate directly in the upside you help create. As we scale, so will your opportunities, responsibilities, and impact.

Strong Team: Work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and operators.

Responsibilities

  • Project and client management: Partner directly with the safety, alignment, and trust & safety teams at frontier AI labs — scoping their hardest data problems, translating them into deliverable programs, and driving revenue.

  • Manage expert teams: Recruit and lead specialized contributors — red teamers, security researchers, trust & safety practitioners, and domain risk experts — and hold a high bar on the quality of what they produce.

  • Shape how frontier models are made safe: Design the specifications behind adversarial datasets, jailbreak and attack taxonomies, refusal-boundary and over-refusal sets, and safety benchmarks that labs use to measure and improve model behavior.

  • Build the red teaming machinery: Stand up repeatable methodologies — human red team campaigns, automated attack generation, coverage tracking against harm taxonomies — rather than one-off deliverables.

  • End-to-end execution: Own projects from first conversation through final delivery, in a fast-moving environment where the spec often does not exist yet.

  • Operational impact: Support initiatives across building, analysis, coordination, and execution as we scale the safety practice.

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years in AI safety, red teaming, trust & safety, adversarial ML, or security research; at a frontier AI lab, FAANG, top security firm, or equivalent.

  • Hands-on adversarial experience: jailbreaking or stress-testing frontier models, prompt injection research, offensive security, penetration testing, bug bounty, CTFs, or trust & safety investigations and enforcement.

  • Fluency with how safety work is actually structured (harm taxonomies, evaluation design, safety frameworks and model policy).

  • High agency and the ability to execute in ambiguity; comfort defining the problem before solving it.

  • Strong writing. Much of this job is specifying risk precisely enough that fifty other people can execute against it.

  • Genuine passion for AI and interest in entrepreneurship.

  • Demonstrated track record of competitive success.

  • Strong leadership and communication skills.

  • Python proficiency and the ability to write production-quality code.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Published safety, alignment, or security research.

  • Track record in bug bounty, CTF, or model red teaming competitions.

  • Experience building automated red teaming or eval pipelines.

  • Depth in a high-consequence risk domain (cyber, bio, fraud and financial crime, child safety, influence operations).

  • Experience using AI tools to automate workflows and build products.

Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend

About AfterQuery

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company's success. Join at an early stage, grow alongside the business, and participate directly in the upside you help create. As we scale, so will your opportunities, responsibilities, and impact.

Strong Team: Work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and operators.

Overview

Growth Engineering is where engineering meets the company’s most important commercial and user-facing problems. You will build the product systems that help us find, qualify, activate, and retain exceptional experts — and help the teams serving frontier AI labs move faster with better information and less manual work.

This is a hands-on product engineering role for someone with 3–5 years of experience who wants unusually high ownership. You will work directly with Growth, Operations, Design, and the founders, turning ambiguous opportunities into simple, reliable software that drives measurable outcomes.

Responsibilities

  • Build end-to-end product experiences across expert acquisition, onboarding, assessments, matching, activation, and retention.

  • Partner directly with Growth and Operations to identify the highest-leverage bottlenecks, instrument the funnel, and ship improvements quickly.

  • Own experiments from idea through implementation and measurement: define the hypothesis, build the product, assess the result, and iterate.

  • Develop internal tools and automation that make customer-facing and operational teams dramatically more effective without compromising quality or control.

  • Create durable product primitives and clean interfaces rather than one-off workflows; improve existing systems as you touch them.

  • Use data, user feedback, and technical judgment to make clear tradeoffs between speed, reliability, and long-term maintainability.

Required Qualifications

  • 3–5 of professional software engineering experience, ideally building high-velocity product, growth, marketplace, or workflow software.

  • Strong full-stack engineering ability and a track record of shipping user-facing product from ambiguous requirements.

  • Excellent product sense: you can distinguish the real problem from the first requested solution and focus on what will move the metric.

  • Comfort working closely with non-technical partners and translating their needs into simple, robust systems.

  • High ownership, strong judgment, and the ability to move quickly without creating unnecessary complexity.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with growth engineering, marketplace liquidity, onboarding, conversion optimization, or product analytics.

  • Experience at a fast-growing startup or on a lean team where engineers owned both product decisions and execution.

  • Interest in AI, data products, or tools that make complex work more scalable.

Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

You will turn open-ended research goals into clear plans, keep researchers, engineers, SPLs and external partners aligned, and surface the decisions and blockers that matter.   • Own planning and execution across post-training, enterprise post-training, fellowship, and public evaluation programs.

  • Maintain a trustworthy view of program health, including experiment progress, risks, blockers, partner dependencies, and upcoming releases.

Required Qualifications

  • 2-4 years project/program management experience

  • Experience leading complex technical programs across research, machine learning, engineering, or data organizations

  • Working knowledge of the LLM development lifecycle, including data creation, SFT, RL-based post-training, and evaluation

  • Strong communication and an ability to turn messy technical information into clear decisions and next steps

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

About AfterQuery

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company's success. Join at an early stage, grow alongside the business, and participate directly in the upside you help create. As we scale, so will your opportunities, responsibilities, and impact.

Strong Team: Work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and operators.

Overview

This is a Business Recruiter role, working closely with our Lead Business Recruiter and the founding team. You will drive full-cycle hiring for our business and operations functions — Strategic Projects, Operations, GTM, and every business-side function we build out — using the sourcing engine, interview rubrics, and closing motion the team is building to bring in elite talent across every business-side hire we make.

You should be excited to recruit at the same caliber bar that built the rest of the team — Jane Street, Citadel Securities, Meta, Google, Palantir, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Silver Lake, MBB consulting, top PE, and top hedge funds. The most consequential talent in the market is increasingly choosing AI. We need someone who can identify it, get them in the room, and close.

What you'll do

  • Run full-cycle recruiting for AfterQuery's business and operations roles — sourcing, screening, interviewing, and closing top-tier candidates across Strategic Project Operations, GTM, and other key business functions we build out.

  • Build deep, proactive talent pipelines from elite finance, consulting, PE, and tech firms — the same caliber bar as our existing team — and convert them.

  • Partner with the Lead Business Recruiter and the executive team to define hiring profiles, prioritize searches, and run rigorous interview processes that test for agency, drive, and judgment.

  • Support recruiting infrastructure across the company — scorecards, interview rubrics, sourcing tooling, the candidate experience, and the offer-and-close motion that turns interest into signed contracts.

  • Close candidates and represent AfterQuery's mission, momentum, and opportunity compellingly to the highest-bar talent in the market.

  • Treat recruiting as a measurable function — track your funnel, model conversion at every stage, and iterate on what's working.

What we're looking for

  • 4-7+ years of experience across agency and in-house recruiting. A track record of identifying, attracting, and closing strong talent.

  • Intense work ethic, agency, and drive. You're a builder first, and thrive in ambiguity.

  • Competitive nature and demonstrated past success across whatever you've done.

  • Strong communication skills — you can hold your own opposite a founder, a Jane Street trader, or a GTM leader, and you build pipelines that founders trust.

  • A genuine interest in the AfterQuery thesis: that the future of AI is bottlenecked on human data, and that the talent generating, designing, and bringing that data to market is the most important hiring decision the company makes.

  • High agency, low ego, speedy but thoughtful. Comfortable in a 5-day in-office SF environment that prizes speed and direct feedback.

Bonus

  • Experience recruiting at a top executive search firm (e.g., Spencer Stuart, Heidrick, Egon Zehnder, Russell Reynolds, True Search, Daversa), a strong in-house recruiting team, or a high-growth tech/AI startup.

  • Prior experience hiring for finance, consulting, PE, or operationally rigorous business roles — and a personal network in those pools.

  • Making a pivot into AI from a strong track record elsewhere — finance, consulting, search, or operating roles — with demonstrated success.

Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend

About AfterQuery

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company's success. Join at an early stage, grow alongside the business, and participate directly in the upside you help create. As we scale, so will your opportunities, responsibilities, and impact.

Strong Team: Work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and operators.

Key Responsibilities

Project and client management: Work with the world’s leading AI organizations to build next-generation data solutions that push the limits of model capability, while directly driving revenue.

Manage expert teams across domains: Lead and coordinate highly specialized contributors across fields like finance, software engineering, law, and more to create high-quality outputs at scale.

Shape how AI systems are trained: Design dataset specifications that directly influence how frontier models are evaluated and improved. Your taste and judgement will shape what foundation models become.

Drive high-impact execution end-to-end: Own critical projects from idea to delivery. From scoping, executing, iterating, and shipping in a fast-moving, high-stakes environment, you will touch it all.

Gain top tier operational experience: Support the team across a range of operational initiatives that will directly contribute to the future of AfterQuery. You will work across multiple parts of the business in the same week, ranging from building, analyzing, coordinating, and executing where needed most.

Required Qualifications

  • PhD (completed or ABD) in biology, chemistry, mathematics, data analytics/statistics, or a related STEM field — or equivalent demonstrated excellence as an IOI, IMO, or USAPhO medalist, ICPC or USACO finalist, or Putnam top 500 finisher

  • Background in scientific research, computational modeling, experimental design, or quantitative/statistical analysis within your field

  • Deep understanding of core fundamentals in your discipline along with strong quantitative and systems-level reasoning

  • High agency and strong work ethic; comfort defining problems and thriving with minimal direction in ambiguous situations

  • Demonstrated leadership excellence and strong communication abilities

  • Genuine passion for AI and an entrepreneurial inclination

  • Demonstrated competitive success (e.g., publications, research awards, fellowships, or the medals/finals listed above)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience with Python, R, or another language used for data analysis

  • Familiarity with how LLMs are trained, fine-tuned, or evaluated

  • Familiarity with AI tools and workflows

Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend

About AfterQuery

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company's success. Join at an early stage, grow alongside the business, and participate directly in the upside you help create. As we scale, so will your opportunities, responsibilities, and impact.

Strong Team: Work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and operators.

The AfterQuery Research Fellow program welcomes experienced researchers from AI and other disciplines who want to apply their expertise to frontier AI research and help push the boundaries of model capabilities. Fellows join us in our San Francisco office for 12–16 weeks of full-time, paid research.

Projects are tailored to each fellow’s expertise and interests, with focus areas including:

  • Data quality and data composition

  • Post-training, including supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning

  • Agent and foundation-model evaluation

  • Public benchmarks in coding and specialized domains such as medicine, finance, law, and STEM

The goal is to develop the work into a joint publication or public benchmark. Fellows receive weekly mentorship and hands-on support with engineering, datasets, human annotation, and compute resources.

Responsibilities

  • Define and execute a full-time project with an AfterQuery research mentor, aligned with your interests and at least one core research area.

  • Formulate research questions, design rigorous experiments, and analyze the results.

  • Develop the datasets, methods, evaluations, or benchmark assets the project needs.

  • Document methods and results clearly and work with AfterQuery’s research and engineering teams to make the work reproducible.

  • Co-author a paper and work toward publication.

Required Qualifications

  • Significant academic, clinical, legal, or industry research experience.

  • Clear technical communication and strong scientific writing skills.

  • A strong record of research or publication and demonstrated ability to take a project from initial scoping to rigorous, reproducible results.

  • A passion for advancing frontier AI and some understanding of model evaluation.

  • Availability to work full time in San Francisco for 12–16 weeks.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Publications at leading conferences or in peer-reviewed journals

  • PhD, MD, JD, or equivalent advanced degree in a relevant field, or late-stage PhD candidate

  • Deep domain expertise in medicine, finance, law, STEM, or another specialized field

  • Availability of 20+ hours per week; in-person preferred

Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend

About AfterQuery

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company's success. Join at an early stage, grow alongside the business, and participate directly in the upside you help create. As we scale, so will your opportunities, responsibilities, and impact.

Technical Content Writer (Contract)

Location: Remote, US-based

Commitment: Approximately 10–15 hours per week to start, with potential to expand based on content needs. Weekly deliverables will be prioritized together across social media, blog posts, and other public-facing content.

Compensation: $60/hour

Contract: Six-month contract

Overview

We’re looking for a contract Technical Content Writer to help shape AfterQuery’s voice across our public-facing written content. You’ll communicate our work as a research lab curating human data for AI through social media, founder content, blog articles, and other company communications.

You’ll work closely with our marketing team, founders, and researchers to turn ideas, technical developments, and company updates into clear, compelling writing. This role spans technical and non-technical content, with audiences ranging from AI researchers and top labs to experts and prospective hires.

Responsibilities

  • Write and adapt content for AfterQuery’s brand and founder social media accounts, including X and LinkedIn, maintaining a distinct and consistent voice for each

  • Develop technical and non-technical blog posts covering research, industry perspectives, company updates, and stories from our team and expert community

  • Turn research papers, technical findings, and conversations with subject-matter experts into accurate, accessible content

  • Draft founder thought leadership, hiring posts, announcements, and other public-facing written materials

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to gather input, refine messaging, and incorporate feedback

  • Repurpose ideas across channels, adapting the tone, depth, and format to each audience

  • Verify claims and sources, maintain editorial quality, and manage agreed content priorities and deadlines

Required Qualifications

  • Experience writing content for an AI, software, data infrastructure, or other technical organization

  • Working understanding of AI and machine learning, with the ability to research unfamiliar topics and explain technical concepts accurately

  • Strong writing and editing skills across social media, long-form articles, and company communications

  • Ability to adapt between founder, brand, and contributor voices and write for both technical and non-technical audiences

  • A portfolio demonstrating clear thinking, strong storytelling, and attention to detail

  • Ability to turn briefs, conversations, and source material into polished drafts while managing a part-time workload independently

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience writing about foundation models, training data, human feedback, or model evaluation

  • Experience ghostwriting for founders, executives, or technical experts

  • Background working with researchers, engineers, or early-stage startup teams

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend

About AfterQuery

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company's success. Join at an early stage, grow alongside the business, and participate directly in the upside you help create. As we scale, so will your opportunities, responsibilities, and impact.

Strong Team: Work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and operators.

Responsibilities

  • Work closely with engineers, operators, and internal users to deeply understand their workflows and pain points

  • Identify the highest-leverage product and infrastructure problems across the company

  • Turn ambiguous problems into clear product direction and technical requirements

  • Partner with Engineering to ship products and systems quickly

  • Balance immediate business needs with long-term scalability and maintainability

  • Own product areas end-to-end, from problem discovery through launch and iteration

  • Use data, user feedback, and business context to prioritize what we build

  • Help standardize and improve workflows as AfterQuery scales

Required Qualifications

  • Strong technical fluency; prior experience in software engineering, ML, or data is a strong plus

  • High ownership and ability to operate independently in ambiguous environments

  • Strong product judgment and ability to identify the underlying problem behind user requests

  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work across technical and operational teams

  • Bias toward action and comfort moving quickly with incomplete information

  • Strong user empathy and willingness to spend significant time understanding how people actually work

  • Ability to synthesize fragmented feedback into clear priorities and product direction

Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend

About AfterQuery

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company's success. Join at an early stage, grow alongside the business, and participate directly in the upside you help create. As we scale, so will your opportunities, responsibilities, and impact.

Strong Team: Work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and operators.

What You'll Do

Sales Enablement

  • Create and maintain sales collateral, presentations, account materials, and other resources that help the sales team sell effectively

  • Partner with sales leadership to develop decks, talking points, templates, and other enablement materials

  • Help ensure sales teams have the right information and resources at the right time

  • Organize and maintain sales resources so they are easy for the team to find and use

  • Support onboarding and training materials for new members of the sales organization

Sales Process & Execution

  • Help manage and improve day-to-day sales processes and workflows

  • Coordinate internally to gather information needed for RFIs, proposals, questionnaires, and customer requests

  • Own follow-ups across internal teams to make sure sales requests are completed on time

  • Help identify bottlenecks in the sales process and find ways to make workflows more efficient

  • Partner with sales, operations, legal, finance, and other teams to keep deals moving

  • Bring structure and organization to processes that may not yet be fully defined

Sales Operations

  • Support the sales team with account and opportunity-related projects

  • Help maintain accurate sales information and documentation

  • Assist with organizing pipeline and account information

  • Build lightweight processes and tools that make the sales team's day-to-day work easier

  • Take on ad hoc projects that improve sales productivity and execution

Sales Analytics & Reporting

  • Support basic reporting and analysis on sales activity, accounts, and customer trends

  • Help turn sales data into useful insights for the team

  • Partner with leadership to answer questions about pipeline, customers, and sales performance

  • Over time, contribute to projections and forecasting as the sales organization scales

What We're Looking For

  • 1+ years of experience in sales operations, sales enablement, business operations, consulting, investment banking, project management, or a similar role

  • Strong organizational and project management skills

  • Excellent written and verbal communication

  • Strong attention to detail and follow-through

  • Ability to work cross-functionally and effectively chase down information from multiple stakeholders

  • Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to figure things out independently

  • Ability to create clear, polished presentations and written materials

  • Comfortable working with data and spreadsheets, even if you don't come from a traditional analytics or RevOps background

  • High agency — you see something that needs to get done and take ownership of getting it done

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment

  • Strong judgment and ability to prioritize competing requests

Nice to Have

  • Background in investment banking, management consulting, business operations, or another highly analytical and execution-oriented environment

  • Experience supporting a high-growth sales organization

  • Experience creating sales decks, enablement materials, or customer-facing collateral

  • Experience managing RFIs, RFPs, proposals, or similar sales processes

  • Experience with CRM or sales tools such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar platforms

  • Experience with basic sales reporting or pipeline analysis

What We Value

High Agency: You don't wait for someone to tell you what to do. You identify problems, figure out solutions, and see them through.

Ownership: You take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks.

Speed: We move quickly and expect people to be comfortable making progress without perfect information.

Attention to Detail: Small things matter, especially when you're supporting a growing sales organization.

Resourcefulness: You know how to find answers, bring the right people together, and get things done.

Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend

About AfterQuery

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company's success. Join at an early stage, grow alongside the business, and participate directly in the upside you help create. As we scale, so will your opportunities, responsibilities, and impact.

Strong Team: Work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and operators.

Key Responsibilities

Project and client management: Work with the world’s leading AI organizations to build next-generation data solutions that push the limits of model capability, while directly driving revenue.

Manage expert teams across domains: Lead and coordinate highly specialized contributors across fields like finance, software engineering, law, and more to create high-quality outputs at scale.

Shape how AI systems are trained: Design dataset specifications that directly influence how frontier models are evaluated and improved. Your taste and judgement will shape what foundation models become.

Drive high-impact execution end-to-end: Own critical projects from idea to delivery. From scoping, executing, iterating, and shipping in a fast-moving, high-stakes environment, you will touch it all.

Gain top tier operational experience: Support the team across a range of operational initiatives that will directly contribute to the future of AfterQuery. You will work across multiple parts of the business in the same week, ranging from building, analyzing, coordinating, and executing where needed most.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of industry or applied research experience in chemical engineering, biochemical engineering, biotechnology, pharmaceutical sciences, biomedical engineering, or a related life-sciences field.

  • Strong technical background in at least one relevant discipline, such as chemical process design, process modeling and optimization, bioprocess engineering, drug development, or biomedical systems.

  • Deep understanding of scientific and engineering fundamentals within your area of expertise, with the ability to evaluate technical reasoning, identify errors, and assess real-world constraints and tradeoffs.

  • High agency and strong work ethic; comfort defining problems and thriving with minimal direction in ambiguous situations.

  • Demonstrated leadership excellence and strong communication abilities.

  • Genuine passion for AI and an entrepreneurial inclination.

  • Demonstrated competitive success (e.g., patents, publications, research awards, or top-tier academic/professional achievement).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Python or experience with scientific computing, process simulation, or analysis tools relevant to your discipline (e.g., Aspen Plus, Aspen HYSYS, MATLAB, COMSOL, or computational biology tools).

  • Advanced degree (MS/PhD) in chemical engineering, biomedical engineering, biotechnology, chemistry, biology, or a related field.

  • Experience in chemical manufacturing, pharmaceutical development, biotechnology, bioprocessing, or medical-device development.

  • Familiarity with Claude Code or similar AI-assisted workflows.

Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend
