About AfterQuery

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company's success. Join at an early stage, grow alongside the business, and participate directly in the upside you help create. As we scale, so will your opportunities, responsibilities, and impact.

Strong Team: Work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and operators.

Overview

We're looking for a Head of Enterprise GTM to own and build AfterQuery's enterprise go-to-market function from the ground up. This person will be responsible for driving enterprise customer acquisition, developing strategic commercial partnerships, structuring complex deals, and ensuring successful delivery of the engagements we sell.

This is a senior, highly autonomous leadership role for someone who can operate as both a strategic leader and a hands-on individual contributor. You will personally identify and pursue high-value enterprise opportunities, build relationships with senior decision-makers, lead complex sales cycles, and translate customer needs into commercially sound engagements that our research and technical teams can execute.

Our core research and technical capabilities are already in place. The primary challenge is bringing those capabilities to the right customers, creating compelling commercial opportunities, and converting them into successful, long-term partnerships. You'll work closely with our researchers and technical leadership to understand what we can deliver, while taking full ownership of how we position, sell, structure, and bring those solutions to market.

You'll own the entire customer lifecycle, from initial prospecting and relationship development through commercial negotiation, engagement launch, delivery, and account expansion. This includes building the operating processes and commercial infrastructure needed to scale the function, as well as establishing and leading a high-performing GTM team as the business grows.

We're looking for someone who can independently drive results from day one, create structure where little exists, and build a repeatable enterprise GTM engine without relying on an existing sales organization or extensive support.

What You'll Do

Own and Build the Enterprise GTM Function

  • Take full ownership of AfterQuery's enterprise go-to-market strategy, commercial execution, and overall customer acquisition efforts.

  • Define and execute the strategy for identifying, pursuing, and closing high-value enterprise opportunities across AI, technology, and other relevant industries.

  • Personally drive outbound prospecting, relationship development, pipeline generation, and strategic account acquisition while building the foundation for a scalable sales organization.

  • Establish our enterprise sales motion, including target account strategy, qualification, positioning, pricing, deal structures, and commercial negotiations.

  • Identify the highest-value customer use cases for custom evaluations, data generation, model training, and post-training engagements.

  • Build the processes, playbooks, metrics, and operating cadence needed to create a repeatable and scalable GTM function.

  • Establish, hire, and lead a high-performing enterprise GTM team as the business scales, setting clear expectations for performance, accountability, and execution.

Drive Enterprise Sales and Commercial Strategy

  • Build and own relationships with senior executives, business leaders, and technical decision-makers across large enterprise organizations.

  • Lead consultative discovery to understand customer workflows, business objectives, technical requirements, and opportunities for AI-driven improvement.

  • Translate customer problems into compelling commercial opportunities, developing proposals that connect AfterQuery's capabilities to measurable business outcomes.

  • Own the full sales cycle, from initial outreach and discovery through solution scoping, pricing, contracting, and deal closure.

  • Structure sophisticated enterprise agreements, balancing customer needs, commercial economics, delivery requirements, and long-term business value.

  • Lead complex commercial negotiations, including pricing models, engagement structures, contract terms, and expansion opportunities.

  • Develop strategic account relationships that generate repeat business, long-term partnerships, and broader enterprise adoption.

Translate Customer Needs into Executable Engagements

  • Partner closely with AfterQuery's research and technical leadership to understand our capabilities and translate them into differentiated enterprise solutions.

  • Identify and scope technical engagements involving model evaluations, failure analysis, training data, and post-training approaches such as supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning.

  • Work with research and technical teams to determine feasibility, resource requirements, timelines, and delivery expectations before committing to customer engagements.

  • Translate customer requirements into clearly defined scopes of work, deliverables, success metrics, and commercially viable engagement structures.

  • Ensure alignment between what is sold commercially and what can be successfully executed by our research and delivery teams.

  • Bring customer feedback, market intelligence, and emerging enterprise needs back to research leadership to inform future capabilities and opportunities.

Own Customer Delivery and Account Expansion

  • Maintain ownership of customer engagements beyond the initial contract, ensuring successful execution and delivery against commercial commitments.

  • Lead the transition from signed agreement to active engagement, coordinating researchers, technical teams, and operational resources.

  • Establish clear accountability for project scope, milestones, deliverables, success criteria, and customer communication.

  • Proactively manage delivery risks, resolve escalations, and ensure customer expectations remain aligned with execution.

  • Monitor engagement performance and commercial outcomes, identifying opportunities to improve delivery models, engagement economics, and customer satisfaction.

  • Turn successful engagements into long-term strategic partnerships, repeat business, case studies, and opportunities for account expansion.

What We're Looking For

  • 7–10+ years of experience in enterprise sales, strategic business development, commercial leadership, or enterprise GTM at a high-growth technology company.

  • A proven track record of independently building enterprise pipelines, acquiring major customers, and closing complex, high-value commercial agreements.

  • Experience leading enterprise GTM or sales functions, ideally in an early-stage or high-growth company where you built the commercial motion from the ground up.

  • Strong commercial judgment and experience structuring sophisticated enterprise deals, including pricing, contracts, resource requirements, and engagement economics.

  • Experience selling complex software, AI solutions, technical services, or research-driven solutions to large enterprise customers.

  • Demonstrated ability to operate as a hands-on individual contributor while providing strategic leadership and direction from day one.

  • Experience owning customer engagements beyond the sale, including implementation, delivery, stakeholder management, and ensuring contractual commitments are met.

  • Strong technical aptitude and the ability to understand complex AI capabilities, engage credibly with technical stakeholders, and translate customer problems into executable solutions.

  • Ability to work closely with research, engineering, and operations teams to scope engagements, align resources, and deliver against customer expectations.

  • A builder's mindset: you take full ownership, operate independently, move quickly, and create structure where little exists.

  • Exceptional executive presence, negotiation, communication, and relationship-building skills.

  • Comfort operating in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment where individual ownership, commercial judgment, and results are essential.

Particularly Relevant Backgrounds

We're particularly interested in candidates who have built and scaled enterprise GTM functions within AI, enterprise software, AI infrastructure, or technical services businesses, as well as commercial leaders who have helped large organizations adopt and implement AI at scale.

Relevant experience may include:

  • Head of Enterprise Sales, VP of GTM, Chief Commercial Officer, or similar leadership roles at high-growth technology companies.

  • Enterprise AI companies selling complex, high-value solutions to frontier AI labs, Fortune 500 companies, or sophisticated enterprise customers.

  • AI implementation and transformation leaders at top management consulting firms (MBB) who have led enterprise AI strategy, deployment, and implementation initiatives, working directly with C-suite stakeholders and translating complex business challenges into technical solutions.

  • AI infrastructure, technical services, or applied research businesses where commercial leaders own both deal structuring and customer delivery.

  • Early-stage companies where the candidate personally generated pipeline, closed strategic accounts, established commercial processes, and built a sales organization.

  • Experience managing large enterprise contracts, complex implementations, and long-term strategic customer relationships.

We particularly value candidates who have personally driven revenue, built executive-level relationships, and owned customer outcomes. This could include traditional enterprise sales leaders as well as consulting leaders who have demonstrated the ability to identify commercial opportunities, lead complex AI engagements, and drive successful enterprise implementations.

Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend

About AfterQuery

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company's success. Join at an early stage, grow alongside the business, and participate directly in the upside you help create. As we scale, so will your opportunities, responsibilities, and impact.

Strong Team: Work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and operators.

About the role

This is our first accounting hire, reporting to the Head of Finance & Accounting. You will own the close, revenue recognition, cost matching and our first audit, choose the ERP, and build the accounting function AI-native from the start.

This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to get into the weeds and build. You start as the only in-house accountant, working with our fractional accounting team, and grow the team as the function grows. A prior Controller title is not required. We weigh what you have built over the titles you have held.

What you'll do

Own the books

  • Own the general ledger and the monthly close end to end, including reconciliations and journal entry review.

  • Own revenue recognition under ASC 606 for large, non-recurring contracts with acceptance terms.

  • Own the revenue and cost tie-out from delivery and billing data to the ledger.

  • Define cost of goods sold, variable costs and cost matching, including expert and contractor payments and inference.

  • Direct the fractional accounting team on operational accounting, including AR, AP, cash and equity.

  • Own stock-based compensation accounting and 409A coordination with external valuation specialists.

Make the numbers audit-ready

  • Lead the move to accrual-basis US GAAP financials and our first external audit.

  • Build the controls and evidence a first audit requires.

  • Document material accounting judgments in policies and memos.

Build with AI

  • Automate the close with AI and agentic workflows, with review controls that keep it auditable.

  • Run the bake-off for an AI-forward ERP and own the implementation.

  • Set the roadmap for when to automate, outsource to a vendor, or expand headcount.

Support the company

  • Own tax compliance with external tax advisors, including federal and state filings, estimated payments and contractor information reporting.

  • Own the income tax provision and support tax planning, including credits and incentives.

  • Own the monthly financial statements and the accounting package for the board.

  • Review non-standard contracts with commercial legal and Sales before they are signed.

  • Partner with Revenue Operations and People on expert payments and payroll.

  • Build the team as the function grows.

What we're looking for

  • Automation you built that replaced accounting work, with results you can quantify.

  • ASC 606 experience, ideally with services or usage-based revenue and acceptance terms.

  • Independent judgment on accounting policy, backed by memos that hold up with auditors.

  • Cost accounting experience, including cost matching for a contractor or expert workforce.

  • Advise founders on the accounting impact of deals and decisions before they are made.

  • Hands-on experience running a monthly close end to end.

  • A Big Four audit foundation and hands-on industry experience.

  • A builder who can go from a blank page to a running process without slowing the company down.

  • High ownership, low ego, and comfort with direct feedback. You stay accountable for both the monthly grind and the year-long build.

  • Comfortable in a 5-day in-office SF environment that prizes speed and direct feedback.

Bonus

  • Experience on the company side of an audit.

  • ERP selection or implementation, ideally an AI-forward system.

  • Income tax provision (ASC 740) or corporate tax experience.

  • SQL, Python, BigQuery or Claude Code.

  • CPA.

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend

About AfterQuery

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company's success. Join at an early stage, grow alongside the business, and participate directly in the upside you help create. As we scale, so will your opportunities, responsibilities, and impact.

Strong Team: Work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and operators.

About the role

As our first Social Media & Community Manager, you'll build the AfterQuery Experts brand and community from the ground up. You'll turn our growing expert network into a recognizable, engaged community — one that people want to follow, contribute to, and be part of. Across Instagram, TikTok, X, Facebook, Reddit, and Discord, you'll own our social strategy, create content that gets people talking, and build meaningful connections with experts where they already spend their time.

This is a true ground-floor opportunity to shape our voice, define our presence, and turn a network of talented people into a community with real momentum.

What you'll do

  • Own our social presence: Build and manage AfterQuery Experts across Instagram, TikTok, X, Facebook, Reddit, and Discord, developing a distinct voice and strategy for each platform.

  • Create content people want to engage with: Produce high-quality, high-volume content including short-form videos, carousels, threads, memes, expert spotlights, and behind-the-scenes stories. You'll be hands-on with shooting, editing, and publishing.

  • Build our brand: Develop a recognizable voice, visual identity, and content strategy that makes AfterQuery Experts stand out and gives people a reason to follow us.

  • Grow an engaged community: Show up where experts spend their time, spark conversations, respond to comments and DMs, and build genuine relationships with our expert network.

  • Stay culturally relevant: Keep a pulse on AI, technology, and internet culture. Spot emerging trends, move quickly on relevant moments, and create timely content that feels native to each platform.

  • Turn engagement into growth: Partner with recruiting and growth teams to drive expert awareness, community participation, and sign-ups through organic social.

  • Create community experiences: Organize AMAs, expert spotlights, virtual events, hackathons, and conference activations that bring our community together.

  • Build strategic partnerships: Develop relationships with creators, influencers, university career centers, student organizations, and professional associations to expand our reach.

  • Measure and iterate: Track audience growth, reach, engagement, referral traffic, and expert sign-ups. Use performance insights to continuously improve our content and strategy.

  • Be the voice of our experts: Partner with our expert support team to understand community needs, surface common questions, and turn those insights into useful content and resources.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 2–6 years of experience managing social media, building online communities, or growing an audience for a consumer brand, creator, marketplace, or professional network.

  • A portfolio demonstrating social accounts, campaigns, or communities you've built and grown, ideally with measurable results.

  • Deep familiarity with TikTok, Instagram, X, Reddit, and Discord — you understand the culture, formats, and nuances of each platform.

  • Strong creative instincts and hands-on content production skills, including short-form video, editing, and graphic design (CapCut, Premiere, Final Cut, Canva, Figma, or similar).

  • Excellent writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to develop a distinctive brand voice and adapt your tone to different audiences and platforms.

  • A strong understanding of what drives online engagement, audience growth, and community participation.

  • Highly proactive and resourceful. You're comfortable taking an idea from concept to execution without waiting for someone to tell you what to do.

  • Genuine curiosity about AI, technology, and the people building and shaping the future of AI.

  • Comfortable working in our San Francisco office five days a week in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment.

Preferred

  • Experience building communities for data labeling, gig work, freelance, creator-economy, or professional networks.

  • Experience moderating and growing Reddit or Discord communities.

  • Familiarity with social media analytics and scheduling tools such as Sprout Social, Later, Hootsuite, or native platform dashboards.

  • Experience developing creator, influencer, university, or professional association partnerships.

Why AfterQuery

  • Work at the frontier: your experts produce the data that trains and evaluates the world's leading AI models

  • Real ownership from day one — you will define how expert support works here

  • Small, fast-moving team where your findings reach decision-makers the same day

  • Competitive compensation with meaningful equity

Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend

About AfterQuery

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

Why Apply

Massive Opportunity: Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

Founding Impact: You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

Equity & Growth: Competitive salary and meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company's success. Join at an early stage, grow alongside the business, and participate directly in the upside you help create. As we scale, so will your opportunities, responsibilities, and impact.

Strong Team: Work alongside world-class engineers, researchers, and operators.

About the role

This is our first strategic finance hire, reporting to the Head of Finance & Accounting. You will own planning, budgets and analytics, and build them AI-native from the start, so we run the business off the data and invest in what builds a durable business.

This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to get into the weeds and build. You start as the only person in FP&A, building your own models, data and tools, and grow the team as the function grows. A prior Head of FP&A title is not required. We weigh what you have built over the titles you have held.

What you'll do

Own the plan

  • Own the operating model, the annual plan and the monthly forecast.

  • Set targets and budgets, and help each team understand its headcount and expenses.

  • Build customer- and contract-level unit economics and forecast capacity.

  • Work with teams to optimize fixed and variable costs across experts, inference and compute.

  • Forecast compute and inference spend, and model capacity commitments before we sign them.

  • Own the cash forecast and quarterly tax estimates, so large payments are planned ahead.

Run the business off the data

  • Build the data layer from the ledger, CRM, payroll, spend and delivery systems.

  • Own the metric definitions and the quarterly business review.

  • Deliver budget-vs-actual and variance analysis each month.

  • Partner with Accounting so management reporting ties to the close every month.

Build with AI

  • Automate the planning and reporting cycle with AI and agentic workflows, with checks back to source.

  • Keep the business context encoded so the tools know the business at the start of every cycle.

Support decisions

  • Price new work, run deal reviews and model deal structure with the Delivery, Engagement and Operations teams.

  • Build the business case for new products and verticals before we commit people and spend.

  • Own board and investor materials, and support capital allocation decisions.

What we're looking for

  • Models, data pipelines and AI workflows you built yourself that replaced manual FP&A work, with results you can quantify.

  • Hands-on SQL, Python, Claude Code or Codex experience. You pull your own data and run your own analysis.

  • Comfortable forecasting a business and industry that change quarter to quarter, and updating the assumptions when they do.

  • The judgment to know when an output is wrong.

  • A foundation in investment banking, consulting or strategic finance, and hands-on FP&A at a hyper-growth technology company.

  • You explain the numbers plainly to founders and engineers, and push back with data.

  • High ownership, low ego, and comfort with direct feedback.

  • Comfortable working five days a week in our San Francisco office.

Bonus

  • Modeling a services, usage-based or marketplace business, or inference and compute costs.

  • Building or running a planning process from scratch.

Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):

  • Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend
